'''Robert Kendall Lazarsfeld''' (born April 15, 1953) is an American [[mathematician]] who specializes in [[algebraic geometry]]. He is currently a distinguished professor of mathematics at [[Stony Brook University]].<ref>[http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/~rlaz/index_files/Vita2013.pdf Robert Lazarsfeld's CV]</ref> He was previously the [[Raymond Louis Wilder|Raymond L. Wilder]] Collegiate Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Michigan]].<ref>[http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/people/facultyAlpha.php Univ. of Michigan Mathematics Dept. Faculty Listing] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130521111617/http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/people/facultyAlpha.php |date=May 21, 2013 }}, retrieved October 27, 2010.</ref> He is the son of two sociologists, [[Paul Lazarsfeld]] and [[:fr:Patricia Kendall|Patricia Kendall]]. 

== Career ==
Lazarsfeld received his B.A. from [[Harvard College]] in 1975 and earned his Ph.D. from [[Brown University]] in 1980 under supervision of [[William Fulton (mathematician)|William Fulton]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=4445}}</ref>

From 1983 to 1998, Lazarsfeld was an assistant professor, associate professor, and professor of mathematics at [[University of California, Los Angeles|UCLA]]. He joined the faculty of the [[University of Michigan]] in 1997 and served as the Raymond L. Wilder Collegiate Professor there from 2007 to 2013. In 2013 he joined the faculty of [[Stony Brook University]], where he was the chair of the Mathematics Department from 2016-2019. Since 2015, he is a distinguished professor at Stony Brook. 

From 2002–2009, Lazarsfeld was an editor at the ''[[Journal of the American Mathematical Society]]'' (Managing Editor, 2007–2009).<ref>[https://www.ams.org/publications/journals/journalsframework/jams/editorial_history_jams Past editors of the Journal of the AMS]</ref> In 2012–2013, he served as the Managing Editor of the ''[[Michigan Mathematical Journal]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/mmj/ |title=University of Michigan Michigan Math Journal Site |access-date=February 7, 2013 |archive-date=December 18, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161218080959/http://www.math.lsa.umich.edu/mmj/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
In 2006, Lazarsfeld was elected as a Fellow of the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]].<ref>[http://www.ur.umich.edu/0506/May08_06/03.shtml Three U-M faculty elected to American Academy  of Arts and Sciences.] ''The Record'', May 8, 2006, [[University of Michigan]]. Accessed May 31, 2011</ref>

In 2012 he became a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].<ref>[https://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society], retrieved January 27, 2013.</ref> 

In 2015 he was awarded the AMS [[Leroy P. Steele Prize]] for Mathematical Exposition.<ref>[https://www.ams.org/news?news_id=2464 2015 AMS Leroy P. Steele Prize for Mathematical Exposition]</ref>
